scripts.build: pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-core build && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-notifiers build && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-runtime build && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-guard build && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly build
scripts.build:deploy-template: pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-core build && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-notifiers build && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-runtime build && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-guard build && node scripts/sync-deploy-template.mjs
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-guard db:migrate:remote && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-guard deploy:built
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-core build && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-notifiers build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.verify:runtime-release: pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-runtime build && pnpm --filter @standardagents/brolly-runtime typecheck && pnpm exec vitest run packages/runtime/test/runtime.test.ts
